svg.title: How a download that hangs starts again
svg.desc: Each download gets a limit of its own, well within the five minutes of its step, and a second or third attempt when it fails or hangs. A download of the website ends after 10 seconds without a connection or 30 without the next part of the file, and the hooks try it again after a second and then two. The setup of uv in the Variants gives way after two minutes to a second one from the releases of uv on GitHub. A container whose image failed to download starts again after 10 and then 20 seconds. Only what fails every attempt fails its step, and the flaky-test bot runs that job once more.
